e.s: Viet Cong overrun a South Vietnamese regiment's post near Tây Ninh and carry off its arms.
Eighteen former ministers and notables, Trần Văn Văn and Phan Khắc Sửu among them, meet at the Caravelle Hotel in Saigon and petition Diệm: …
Durbrow to State: Saigon, Nhu most likely behind it, backed a Thai plan for a raid by a hundred "Free Khmers" into Cambodia and flew them French arms.
Hanoi.
Kong Le's paratroop battalion takes Vientiane, the night of Aug.
Vientiane.
Phoumi at Savannakhet moves to retake Vientiane;
Third Congress of the Vietnam Workers' Party, Hanoi.
At Savannakhet, Prince Boun Oum and General Phoumi Nosavan proclaim a "revolution" against Souvanna Phouma's government.
Parsons, Irwin and Riley, with Ambassador Brown, see King Savang Vatthana at Luang Prabang.
Abramov, the Soviet Ambassador to Cambodia, named to Laos Oct.
Durbrow reads Diệm a paper of suggestions, cleared by State Oct.
Brown and Souvanna Phouma: aid to the south if Phoumi accepts the government's authority.
Vientiane.
Paratroops under Col.
The garrison at Luang Prabang, the royal capital, goes over to Phoumi Nosavan.
Souvanna Phouma takes the Pathet Lao into a coalition government;
Saigon.
Vientiane.
Phoumi Nosavan attacks from Savannakhet, on the Thai border, a hundred miles south of Vientiane: three battalions with some tanks.
Vientiane.
The first Soviet supplies land at Vientiane: five Il-14s, forty drums of oil.
Vientiane airport.
Kouprasith's coup in Vientiane, Dec.
Quinim Pholsena, Souvanna Phouma's Minister of Information, asks Abramov's help to fly to Hanoi with Souvanna's letter to Hồ Chí Minh asking …
The assembly, at Savannakhet, votes Souvanna Phouma out;
Phoumi's troops take Vientiane, the American embassy burned;
Abramov and the last of Souvanna Phouma's ministers leave Vientiane.
The National Front for the Liberation of South Vietnam founded at a congress in Tây Ninh province, as the Lao Động party's congress in Hanoi …
